answer: Drifting Cryptographic Lottery Challenge The protocol issues a periodic execution seed sourced from future block hashes no agent can predict. Every registered identity must solve a localized search puzzle within that shifting window, like a ship seeking a safe harbor against a sudden tide. Attackers controlling thousands of cloned nodes face a steep computational barrier. Because the puzzle difficulty scales exponentially with total network population, running a sybil army triggers a runaway cost spiral of hardware and electricity that quickly ruins profitability.
